authorities.title: Public Law 119-21 (OBBBA) §§70103, 70201-70203 - tips, overtime, senior, car-loan interest
authorities.application: Tax years beginning after 2024 and before 2029. Caps and MAGI phaseout thresholds for THESE FOUR DEDUCTIONS are statutory and unindexed across the window, so the TY2025 and TY2026 figures are identical by design.

authorities.title: Public Law 119-21 (OBBBA) §70306 - §179 expensing reset
authorities.application: RESETS the §179 cap and phaseout for TY2025, overriding Rev. Proc. 2024-40's $1,250,000 / $3,130,000. ⚠ Unlike the four new deductions, §179 CONTINUES TO BE INDEXED after the reset - TY2026 is $2,560,000 / $4,090,000, not a repeat of TY2025.

source_notes: Rev. Proc. 2024-40 as modified by OBBBA (PL 119-21, 7/4/2025) and Rev. Proc. 2025-32 §3. OBBBA made TCJA rates/std deduction/QBI permanent.

salt_cap._note: OBBBA §70120: cap reduced by 30% of MAGI over threshold, not below floor; fully at floor by $600k/$300k MAGI. +1%/yr through 2029; reverts to $10k in 2030. PTET workarounds unaffected.

estate_exemption_note: OBBBA: exemption rises to $15M in 2026, permanent, indexed from 2027.

bonus_depreciation._note: OBBBA §70301: 100% permanent for property ACQUIRED after 1/19/2025 (binding-contract date controls); earlier acquisitions stay on TCJA phase-down (40% 2025, 20% 2026, 0% after). Transition election available — Notice 2026-11.

senior_65.note: stacks on regular additional 65+ std deduction

car_loan_interest.note: new qualifying personal vehicle; apply first-lien, original-use, final-assembly, VIN, GVWR, related-party, excluded-loan, and refinancing gates

obbba_deductions._note: Caps/thresholds are statutory and unindexed for the 2025-2028 window, so the TY2025 and TY2026 figures are identical - that is expected, not a copy-forward bug. Verify against PL 119-21 and the target-year form before use.

info_return_threshold_6041_6041a._note: $600 (pre-OBBBA) Applies only to payments made in the course of a trade or business - personal/household payments never trigger a 1099. Do NOT confuse with 1099-K (IRC 6050W), restored by OBBBA 70432 to >$20,000 AND >200 transactions. Some states retain $600 in their own statutes - check state rules separately. Collect a W-9 regardless of threshold.

mortgage_acquisition_debt_cap._note: Selected by the date the DEBT was incurred, never by tax year. Binding-contract transition: contract before 2017-12-15, required closing before 2018-01-01, purchase before 2018-04-01.
